
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/noear/p/20857129" title="发布于 2026-06-27 09:39">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Spring Boot → Solon 注解迁移实战指南：一张对照表说清楚</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        Solon框架与Spring Boot的迁移对照指南 本文为Java开发者提供了从Spring Boot迁移到Solon框架的详细对照表。Solon是一款独立发展的全栈应用框架，设计上遵循主流IoC、AOP、MVC范式，但注解更简洁统一。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>写给正在做技术选型或迁移调研的 Java 开发者</p>
<h2 id="一写在前面">一、写在前面</h2>
<p>如果你会 Spring Boot，那你已经会了一大半 Solon。</p>
<p>Solon 不是 Spring 的分支或封装，它是独立发展的全栈应用开发框架。但在设计哲学上，Solon 遵循了 Java 主流的 IoC、AOP、MVC 范式——<strong>概念相同，注解名不同</strong>。</p>
<p>这篇文章把 Spring Boot 到 Solon 的注解映射、配置迁移、关键差异整理成对照表，供迁移参考。</p>
<h2 id="二iocdi-容器注解对照">二、IoC/DI 容器：注解对照</h2>
<p><strong>核心原则</strong>：Solon 将 Spring 的多个细分注解合并为少数几个核心注解。</p>
<h3 id="21-组件注册">2.1 组件注册</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Solon</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>@Component</code></td>
<td><code>@Component</code> / <code>@Service</code> / <code>@Repository</code> / <code>@Dao</code></td>
<td>Solon 统一用一个注解</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Configuration</code></td>
<td><code>@Configuration</code></td>
<td>完全一致</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Bean</code></td>
<td><code>@Bean</code></td>
<td>完全一致</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="22-依赖注入">2.2 依赖注入</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Solon</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>@Inject</code></td>
<td><code>@Autowired</code></td>
<td>按类型注入（by type）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Inject("name")</code></td>
<td><code>@Qualifier</code> + <code>@Autowired</code></td>
<td>按名称注入（by name）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Inject("${key}")</code></td>
<td><code>@Value("${key}")</code></td>
<td>注入配置值</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@BindProps(prefix="xxx")</code></td>
<td><code>@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="xxx")</code></td>
<td>绑定属性集</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>注意</strong>：Solon 的 <code>@Inject</code> 一个注解兼顾了 Spring 中 <code>@Autowired</code>、<code>@Qualifier</code>、<code>@Value</code> 三个注解的功能。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="23-生命周期与作用域">2.3 生命周期与作用域</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Solon</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>@Init</code></td>
<td><code>@PostConstruct</code></td>
<td>组件初始化回调</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Destroy</code></td>
<td><code>@PreDestroy</code></td>
<td>组件销毁回调</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>LifecycleBean</code></td>
<td><code>InitializingBean</code> + <code>DisposableBean</code></td>
<td>接口方式控制生命周期</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>AppLoadEndEvent</code></td>
<td><code>ApplicationRunner</code> / <code>CommandLineRunner</code></td>
<td>应用启动后执行</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Singleton</code>（默认）</td>
<td><code>@Scope("singleton")</code></td>
<td>单例（Solon 默认）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Singleton(false)</code></td>
<td><code>@Scope("prototype")</code></td>
<td>多例</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Condition(...)</code></td>
<td><code>@ConditionalOnClass</code> / <code>@ConditionalOnProperty</code> 等</td>
<td>Solon 统一为单一注解</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Import</code></td>
<td><code>@Import</code> + <code>@ComponentScan</code></td>
<td>导入组件/配置类</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="三web-层controller-改写">三、Web 层：Controller 改写</h2>
<h3 id="31-注解映射">3.1 注解映射</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Solon</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>@Controller</code></td>
<td><code>@Controller</code> / <code>@RestController</code></td>
<td>Solon 默认 JSON 输出</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Mapping</code></td>
<td><code>@RequestMapping</code></td>
<td>路由映射</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Get</code> + <code>@Mapping</code></td>
<td><code>@GetMapping</code></td>
<td>GET 方法限定</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Post</code> + <code>@Mapping</code></td>
<td><code>@PostMapping</code></td>
<td>POST 方法限定</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Put</code> + <code>@Mapping</code></td>
<td><code>@PutMapping</code></td>
<td>PUT 方法限定</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Delete</code> + <code>@Mapping</code></td>
<td><code>@DeleteMapping</code></td>
<td>DELETE 方法限定</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Param</code></td>
<td><code>@RequestParam</code></td>
<td>请求参数</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Path</code></td>
<td><code>@PathVariable</code></td>
<td>路径变量</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Body</code></td>
<td><code>@RequestBody</code></td>
<td>请求体</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Header</code></td>
<td><code>@RequestHeader</code></td>
<td>请求头</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Cookie</code></td>
<td><code>@CookieValue</code></td>
<td>Cookie</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Produces</code></td>
<td>—（Spring 无直接等价）</td>
<td>声明输出类型</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Consumes</code></td>
<td>—（Spring 无直接等价）</td>
<td>声明输入类型</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="32-before--after-示例">3.2 Before / After 示例</h3>
<p><strong>Spring Boot 写法：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
@RequestMapping("/users")
public class UserController {
    
    @Autowired
    private UserService userService;
    
    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public User getUser(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return userService.findById(id);
    }
    
    @PostMapping
    public User create(@RequestBody User user) {
        return userService.save(user);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Solon 写法：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Controller
@Mapping("/users")
public class UserController {
    
    @Inject
    private UserService userService;
    
    @Get
    @Mapping("/{id}")
    public User getUser(@Path Long id) {
        return userService.findById(id);
    }
    
    @Post
    @Mapping
    public User create(@Body User user) {
        return userService.save(user);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="33-关键差异context-替代-servlet-api">3.3 关键差异：Context 替代 Servlet API</h3>
<p>Solon <strong>不依赖 Servlet 容器</strong>，因此 <code>HttpServletRequest</code> / <code>HttpServletResponse</code> 需替换为 <code>Context</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// Spring 写法
public User get(HttpServletRequest request) {
    String token = request.getHeader("Token");
    String id = request.getParameter("id");
}

// Solon 写法
public User get(Context ctx) {
    String token = ctx.header("Token");
    String id = ctx.param("id");
    // ctx.redirect(url) 重定向
    // ctx.render(obj)    渲染
    // ctx.remoteIp()     客户端 IP
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ <code>Context</code> 只能在方法参数中注入，不能作为字段注入。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="四配置文件迁移">四、配置文件迁移</h2>
<h3 id="41-文件命名">4.1 文件命名</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>项目</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>Solon</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>主配置文件</td>
<td><code>application.yml</code></td>
<td><code>app.yml</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>环境配置文件</td>
<td><code>application-dev.yml</code></td>
<td><code>app-dev.yml</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>激活方式</td>
<td><code>spring.profiles.active=dev</code></td>
<td><code>solon.env=dev</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="42-常用配置键名对照">4.2 常用配置键名对照</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>含义</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>Solon</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>应用名</td>
<td><code>spring.application.name</code></td>
<td><code>solon.app.name</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>端口</td>
<td><code>server.port</code></td>
<td><code>server.port</code>（不变）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>上下文路径</td>
<td><code>server.servlet.context-path</code></td>
<td><code>server.contextPath</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>数据源</td>
<td><code>spring.datasource.url</code></td>
<td><code>solon.dataSources.db1.url</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>日志级别</td>
<td><code>logging.level.com.xx</code></td>
<td><code>solon.logging.level.com.xx</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>环境切换</td>
<td><code>spring.profiles.active</code></td>
<td><code>solon.env</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ Solon 配置键名统一使用<strong>驼峰命名</strong>（<code>contextPath</code>），不是短横线（<code>context-path</code>）。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="五数据访问db-一站式注入">五、数据访问：@Db 一站式注入</h2>
<h3 id="51-多数据源配置yaml">5.1 多数据源配置（YAML）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">solon.dataSources:
  db1:
    class: com.zaxxer.hikari.HikariDataSource
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost/test
    driverClassName: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
    username: root
    password: 123456
  db2:
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost/order
    driverClassName: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
    username: root
    password: 123456
</code></pre>
<h3 id="52-db-注入">5.2 @Db 注入</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">// Solon 一行搞定多数据源
@Db("db1") UserMapper userMapper;
@Db("db2") OrderMapper orderMapper;
</code></pre>
<p>对比 Spring Boot 多数据源需要配置：多个 <code>DataSource</code> + 多个 <code>SqlSessionFactory</code> + 多个 <code>TransactionManager</code> + <code>@MapperScan</code>... <strong>Solon 使用 <code>@Db</code></strong>。</p>
<h3 id="53-orm-集成">5.3 ORM 集成</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>ORM</th>
<th>Spring Boot 依赖</th>
<th>Solon 依赖</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>MyBatis</td>
<td><code>mybatis-spring-boot-starter</code></td>
<td><code>mybatis-solon-plugin</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>MyBatis-Plus</td>
<td><code>mybatis-plus-spring-boot-starter</code></td>
<td><code>mybatis-plus-solon-plugin</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>JPA</td>
<td><code>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</code></td>
<td><code>solon-data-jpa</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Easy-Query</td>
<td><code>easy-query-spring-boot-starter</code></td>
<td><code>easy-query-solon-plugin</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="54-事务">5.4 事务</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Solon</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>@Transaction</code></td>
<td><code>@Transactional</code></td>
<td>声明式事务</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Transaction(policy = TranPolicy.requires_new)</code></td>
<td><code>@Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW)</code></td>
<td>事务传播策略</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<blockquote>
<p>Solon 的 <code>@Transaction</code> 默认遇到任何异常都回滚，无需指定异常类型。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="六测试迁移">六、测试迁移</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Solon</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>@SolonTest(App.class)</code></td>
<td><code>@SpringBootTest</code></td>
<td>测试启动</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@SolonTest(env="test")</code></td>
<td><code>@ActiveProfiles("test")</code></td>
<td>测试环境</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>HttpTester</code></td>
<td><code>MockMvc</code></td>
<td>HTTP 接口测试</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Rollback</code></td>
<td><code>@Transactional</code> + <code>@Rollback</code></td>
<td>事务回滚</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>@Import(profiles=...)</code></td>
<td><code>@TestPropertySource</code></td>
<td>导入测试属性</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>HttpTester 用法示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@SolonTest(App.class)
public class UserControllerTest extends HttpTester {
    
    @Test
    public void testGetUser() {
        // GET 请求
        String resp = path("/users/1").get();
        assertEquals(200, resp.code());
        
        // POST 请求
        String json = "{\"name\":\"test\"}";
        String resp2 = path("/users").body(json).post();
        assertContains(resp2, "test");
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="七其他常见对照">七、其他常见对照</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>场景</th>
<th>Spring Boot</th>
<th>Solon</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>拦截器</td>
<td><code>HandlerInterceptor</code></td>
<td><code>@Around</code> 注解或 Solon Filter</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>定时任务</td>
<td><code>@Scheduled</code></td>
<td><code>@Scheduled</code>（同名）+ <code>@EnableScheduling</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>文件上传</td>
<td><code>MultipartFile</code></td>
<td><code>UploadedFile</code>（用法一致）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>RPC 调用</td>
<td><code>@FeignClient</code></td>
<td><code>@NamiClient</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>注册发现</td>
<td><code>@EnableDiscoveryClient</code></td>
<td><strong>无需注解</strong>，引入插件自动生效</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>配置刷新</td>
<td><code>@RefreshScope</code></td>
<td><strong>无需注解</strong>，配置变更自动感知</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="八迁移检查清单">八、迁移检查清单</h2>
<ul class="contains-task-list">
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> POM：<code>spring-boot-starter-parent</code> → <code>solon-parent</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> POM：<code>spring-boot-starter-*</code> → <code>solon-*</code> / <code>*-solon-plugin</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 配置：<code>application.yml</code> → <code>app.yml</code>（环境文件同理）</label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 启动类：<code>@SpringBootApplication</code> → <code>@SolonMain</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 启动：<code>SpringApplication.run()</code> → <code>Solon.start()</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> IoC：<code>@Autowired</code> → <code>@Inject</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> IoC：<code>@Service</code>/<code>@Repository</code> → <code>@Component</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> Web：<code>@RestController</code> → <code>@Controller</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> Web：<code>@RequestMapping</code> → <code>@Mapping</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> Web：<code>@PathVariable</code> → <code>@Path</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> Web：<code>HttpServletRequest</code> → <code>Context</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 配置：<code>@Value</code> → <code>@Inject("${...}")</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 数据：<code>spring.datasource.*</code> → <code>solon.dataSources.*</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 数据：<code>@Transactional</code> → <code>@Transaction</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 测试：<code>@SpringBootTest</code> → <code>@SolonTest</code></label></li>
<li class="task-list-item"><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="" type="checkbox"><label> 测试：<code>MockMvc</code> → <code>HttpTester</code></label></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="九写在最后">九、写在最后</h2>
<p>这篇对照表覆盖了日常开发中最常用的 90% 场景。Solon 的注解体系并非简单的"换皮"，它在统一性（<code>@Component</code> / <code>@Inject</code> / <code>@Condition</code>）和简便性（<code>@Db</code> / 无需 <code>@RefreshScope</code>）上做了明显的设计取舍。</p>
<p>建议迁移前先通读一遍官方对比文档：<a href="https://solon.noear.org/article/compare-springboot" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">solon.noear.org/article/compare-springboot</a></p>
<p>如有具体的迁移场景未覆盖，欢迎在评论区留言。</p>
